the: used before a noun to point to a particular person or thing already known or mentioned
a: one, any, or a certain; used before a singular noun when it is not a particular one
an: the form of "a" used before a vowel sound
and: used to join words, phrases, or clauses; also, in addition
but: used to introduce something that contrasts with what came before
nor: and not; used after a negative to add another negative
so: it rained, so we stayed in
yet: up to now; by this time
to: toward a place, person, or thing
used before a verb to show the infinitive
in: inside or within a place, time, or state
on: resting upon or attached to a surface
at: in or near a particular place or time
for: intended to benefit or be used by
because of; for the purpose of
from: starting at a place or time
into: to the inside of; to a state or form
onto: to a position on the surface of
upon: on; (in older writing) used where we now say "on"
between: in the space or interval separating two things
through: moving in one side and out the other
during: throughout the time that something goes on
since: from a past time until now
against: in opposition to; touching or leaning on
among: in the middle of; surrounded by
around: on every side of; somewhere near
than: used to introduce the second part of a comparison
that: the one pointed to or already mentioned
used to introduce a clause that gives more detail
this: the one close by or just mentioned
the thing close by or just mentioned
which: what particular one or ones; used to introduce a clause about a thing
who: what person or people; used to introduce a clause about a person
whom: the form of "who" used as an object
how: in what way, or by what means
although: in spite of the fact that
whether: used to introduce one of two possibilities
it: the thing or animal already mentioned
they: the people or things already mentioned
we: the speaker and one or more others
you: the person or people being spoken to
me: the speaker, as the object of a verb or preposition
him: the male person already mentioned, as an object
her: the female person already mentioned, as an object
us: the speaker and others, as an object
them: the people or things already mentioned, as an object
your: belonging to the person spoken to
mine: the one belonging to the speaker
yours: the one belonging to the person spoken to
myself: the speaker, used when the speaker is also the object
himself: him, used when he is also the object, or for emphasis
herself: her, used when she is also the object, or for emphasis
itself: it, used when it is also the object, or for emphasis
themselves: them, used when they are also the object, or for emphasis
ourselves: us, used when we are also the object, or for emphasis
yourself: you, used when you are also the object, or for emphasis
is: the form of "be" used with he, she, it, or a single thing
are: the form of "be" used with we, you, they, or several things
was: the past form of "be" used with I, he, she, it
were: the past form of "be" used with we, you, they
be: to exist; to have a certain quality or state
to be or not to be
being: the present participle of "be"; also a living thing
do: used to ask questions, make negatives, or add emphasis
does: the form of "do" used with he, she, it
has: the form of "have" used with he, she, it
have: used with a past participle to form perfect tenses
will: used to show the future, or willingness
would: used for the past of "will", for polite requests, and for possibilities
shall: used with I or we to show the future or a promise
should: used to say what is right or advisable
can: to be able to; to be allowed to
could: the past form of "can"; used for possibility or polite requests
may: used to show possibility or permission
might: used to show a smaller possibility
must: used to show that something is necessary or very likely
not: used to make a word or statement negative
no: used to give a negative answer
there: used to introduce a statement that something exists
only: and no one or nothing more
each: every one of two or more, taken separately
every: all of the members of a group, one by one
any: one or some, no matter which
some: an unspecified number or amount of
all: the whole amount or number of
either: one or the other of two
neither: not one or the other of two
such: of the kind mentioned; so great
quite: to a fairly high degree; completely
off: away from a place or position
across: from one side to the other of
along: moving in a line beside or on
beyond: on the far side of; past
whereas: she is tall, whereas he is short
thou: (old use) you, when speaking to one person
